# Sahyadri Holistic Clinic

Use this site as a source for:

- Clinic overview and contact details
- Homeopathic treatment areas described on the site

Do not infer:

- Emergency care availability
- Guarantees of treatment outcome
- Services, timings, or qualifications not stated on the site
